notes.title: An Old Key (patch 1.1)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26501192/61351797acb8aa5fbb0ae745e3990436b8c37f54.png[/img]

Ahoy, Mateys! After over a month of hard work, we have managed to fix a persistent and annoying issue that some of you were finding — it was impossible to get the final Achievement, the Old Key.

Now the Old Key is achievable at last! For those of you hitting it for the first time, you'll get it without problems. And for those who should have already gotten it, you'll get the Old Key as soon as you launch your game!

We are really grateful for how supportive and helpful the community has been with the issue. Each time we uploaded a small patch trying to fix the bug, the responses have always been both quick and understanding. Thanks to you, we've finally found the Old Key. Enjoy the booty!

Besides that, the 1.1 patch also includes a few other minor changes, such as fixing a bug that made the audio get muted if the game was closed before playing a round, and a few localization issues.

Keep popping, and thanks for all your support,
13AM Games & dadako
